known_secrets.text: He found old, deeper brick foundations buried in the dried Old Canal Bed.
Both he and Kiri independently avoid the same stretch of that dried bed.
He suspects the elders' 'one bad night' version of the Turning isn't the whole story.

unknowns: What exactly is buried under the far Old Canal Bed
Why Yara and Elira both react carefully to that place without explaining why
Meaning of the Signs on the seals
